title: Gulf War
description:
The **Gulf War** began on August 2, 1990, when Iraq invaded Kuwait, and ended on February 28, 1991.

A U.S.-led coalition of 35 nations launched Operation Desert Storm to liberate Kuwait. The war featured extensive use of precision-guided munitions and air power.

Iraq was defeated in just 42 days of combat operations, but Saddam Hussein remained in power until 2003.
